Name: FastGrass
Author: Stitch1959
Description:
[b]OVERVIEW[/b]
Vanilla grass spreads slowly and stays thin, so feeding animals from your own farm means waiting days for it to recover. This mod runs several extra spread passes every morning, keeps every tile at full thickness, and can be limited to the part of the farm you choose.

[b]WHAT IT DOES[/b]
• Runs up to ten spread passes each morning, so new grass appears much faster.
• Lock maximum thickness, so existing and new grass is pushed to four layers every morning.
• Daily cap, a hard limit on how many new tiles may appear per morning, so the farm is not swallowed overnight.
• Safe tile rules by default, no water, no buildings, no occupied tiles and no tiles where grass cannot spawn.
• Optional winter growth, off by default to match vanilla behaviour.
• Optional daily console line with the number of new tiles.

[b]AREA FILTER[/b]
• Restrict the mod to the tiles you pick, everything outside keeps vanilla growth.
• Click a tile to select or deselect it, hold the left mouse button and drag to paint or erase a rectangle.
• The selector draws the current selection, keeps working after each pick, and shows the size of the rectangle while you drag.
• The grid follows the farm tiles, so you can see exactly which squares you are choosing.
• No tile selected means the whole farm, so turning the filter on without picking anything changes nothing.
• Two switches allow selecting and clearing away from the farm, both off by default.

[b]CONTROLS[/b]
• F7 opens the selector on the farm.
• F8 clears the whole selection.
• Esc or gamepad B finishes, and cancels the rectangle you are dragging.
• WASD, the arrow keys, the left stick or the mouse edge pan the farm view.
• All three keys accept a keyboard key, a gamepad button, several single keys, a combination or several combinations.

[b]CONSOLE COMMANDS[/b]
• fastgrass_spread, runs one morning of spreading immediately. Add a number to choose the passes, for example fastgrass_spread 5 for five passes, useful for screenshots and for testing a config quickly.
• fastgrass_area, opens the area selector, same as F7.
• fastgrass_area clear, removes every selected tile and covers the whole farm again.
• fastgrass_area list, prints how many tiles are selected and their bounding box.
• Commands respect your settings, so the daily cap, the tile rules and the area filter still apply.

[b]SETTINGS[/b]
Install Generic Mod Config Menu to change any of these in game.

• Growth speed, spread rounds per day, thickness lock, daily cap.
• Tile rules, only on plantable soil, winter growth, daily log.
• Area filter, use the filter, show the selection on the farm, pick or clear areas, selector and clear hotkeys, cancel key, allow working outside the farm.

[b]COMPATIBILITY[/b]
• Multiplayer, only the host runs the spread, so farms do not double up.
• Save data, no custom save data is stored, the selection lives in config.json and older rectangle selections migrate to tiles automatically.
• Languages, English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Simplified Chinese.

[b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
• SMAPI 4.0.0 or later, tested with 4.5.2, game version 1.6.15.
• Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
